reviews.title: Believe Every One Of These Awful Reviews
reviews.text: Mistakes happen. Flights get delayed and luggage sometimes misses a connection…even when passengers make it. What matters is how the issue is fixed. In the case of Brussels Air, they make every possible effort to make the already challenging situation worse. Much, much worse. Countless messages were ignored. Phone calls that did connect led to answers that were outright lies, several hang-ups, and twice when I got someone to escalate my call to a supervisor, I was transferred to unanswered lines with no voicemail. Our luggage was delivered four days into our vacation. We submitted receipts for the clothes and toiletries we needed to purchase. We literally bought things on a day-by-day basis to keep costs down, knowing that we wouldn’t be fully compensated. They sent us a letter that they would agree to pay an amount that did not even cover the toiletries that we had to buy. We responded that it was an unacceptable number, and asked them to reconsider. They never replied and just sent the check. They have continued to ignore emails, texts and voicemails. Oh, and our flights were on time, but the planes were filthy and the crews were hostile and rude. They charge for bottled water. Sounds great, right? Believe me when I tell you that I’ve had my share of issues with airlines, and I have never been moved to write a review like this. This company is a joke, and you’re better off walking. Avoid at all costs.
reviews.author: mbaNYC

reviews.title: Do Not Expect Any Refund
reviews.text: We booked and paid for exit row seats. At check in we had been separated and moved to standard seats. Brussels Airline did not automatically refund our seat reservation fee. The Airline did not respond to complaints (repeated three times). Customers Services simply refuse to address anything and direct you to the on line complaints system where you receive an automated reference number which, after five weeks is still not even replied to. Personally I doubt this airlines honesty, integrity and interest in their customers and I will actively avoid Brussels Airlines in future. If Brussels Airlines want to check this the complaint reference is 2306-SN-00161
reviews.author: Ian D

reviews.title: Worst airline of the Lufthansa group
reviews.text: Brussel airlines is the worst of the Lufthansa group airlines based on my experience. They do not even offer water which is normally free on Austrian, Lufthansa, and Swiss. Luggage policy at copenhagen was also wierd veryone had to check in their luggage resulting in empty luggage racks in the airplane. On my flight also my seatpocket was broken.
reviews.author: Patrick K

reviews.title: Ms
reviews.text: My first trip back home alone from UK,i booked Brussels Airlines for my journey. All staff were so helpful,the meals were great compared to what I expected the fact that I had paid economy class.I felt safe throughout the whole journey. No trouble,no delays all was perfect. 👌 Good service needs to be appreciated.
reviews.author: Rynee K

reviews.title: Smooth + perfect customer service
reviews.text: Easy boarding experience no fuss from staff, absolutely amazing. Straightforward policies on baggage as well so you know exactly what you can take. Return flight got cancelled unfortunately for almost 24 hours but we couldn't wish for better service. We were ready to pay for everything then claim money back only to find out it's all been taken care off (transfer from airport to the hotel, dinner, breakfast and taxi back to the airport) by the airline without us having to ask for a single thing. If I could give 6* I would! Thank you
reviews.author: Ivana S

reviews.title: Aggressive Attendants
reviews.text: Flew to Berlin from Brussels, first the flight was delayed 40 minutes, then the flight attendants tried to rush everyone on the plane. We had 2 tickets and only one carry on and a hand bag, due to the delay attendants were just putting bags anywhere and being rude about it. We were told to put all our bags on the floor or risk being late. One female attendant snatched the bag from my wife’s hands and thee it on the floor. Not risking any delays or thrown off the flight, we just sat there and took her abuse. NEVER flying Brussels Air ever again.
reviews.author: Sunny B

reviews.title: Cancelled my return flight
reviews.text: Thieves is an appropriate word. They cancelled my return ticket after I missed my 1st flight. They did not ask for my permission, and when I called they used their sales conditions to argue that I needed to let them know without 3 hours of missing my flight, which I unfortunately did after 4 hours. Apparently that's enough to force you to rebook the exact same ticket. Customer service did not even care nor apologized. Oh, and they increased the price of the return ticket several times while I was trying to book it, it went from 180€ to 270€ in less than 30 minutes. Thieves.
reviews.author: Lily

reviews.title: Cabin staff
reviews.text: It was a full Airbus 319 and I was fortunate enough to be in business class. On this flight there was no difference in seating but it was a short flight and so a small meal was made avaialable. A simple sadal with turkey and shaved cheese and a nive seeded roll and 2 pieces of Belgian chocolates. The Cabin chief Denis Croon was extremely helpful and friendly and full of humor. I was very impressed with his language skills. He, knew, so farf as I coud tell 4 languages. I'm not a fan of the Airbus 319, strikes me as a bit of a rattlebox but the servies was wonderful.
reviews.author: Kirk W

reviews.title: You will never get compensation money
reviews.text: My flight from Copenhagen to Brussels was delayed and i arrived 5 later than the expected arrival time. At the gate i was told that there was a problem at Brussel's airport but when i asked for compensation money, which i was entitled to, I was told that the problem was departure delays at Copenhagen airport. This was not true because this was the only delayed flight around that time. The company uses any excuse not to pay compensation money and we are helpless because we can not prove the contrary.
reviews.author: anasancho10

reviews.title: Flight overbooked. No refund and no service. An absolut disgrace!
reviews.text: No refund and compensation for an overbooked flight. Need to sue. On the 05.12.2022 brussels airlines (as often the case) overbooked the flight. Ans now they refuse to pay back the money. They owe me about 1000 euro. Its really os a frdulant company. Know many of such stories.
reviews.author: J s

reviews.title: The Wicked Policies of Brussel Airlines
reviews.text: I bought a flight from Brussels back in March to travel in December. On the advert at the point of sale the criteria was that I could change my booking for £130. 2 weeks before me flying out and required to change the booking. Brussels used tactics such as, not answering the phone, putting me on hold for hours. disconnecting the call. I had asked Brussels to change the booking and come back with a price for the rebooking. it would have ben cheaper to buy another ticket and within the on peak times. I tried to book an open ticket, they said that they did not sell them despite them giving me a quote for an open ticket and the telephonist did not get back to me. Brussels ended up using all the time of me constantly calling them and never having an answer, which is another tactic they have. Please don't use this airline. They don't care about their customers. They even kept my money for the seats that I had booked and when queried they gave their 200 word legislation of how they can keep my money policy on basically how they can keep my money. Do Brussel really want people to read all of their policies prior to them booking. They stole from me £565 even though I wanted to buy another ticket. I ended up up not even travelling.
reviews.author: Jay

reviews.title: False advertising DANGER
reviews.text: Flying with my wife to AMS Booked Bus class online Website advertises 24 Cancel BEFORE the 24 hours decided to cancel Airline refused to refund money Phone agents would not address issue as it was an online purchase Dispute ensued with Credit Card company Airline insisted they were right Finally with all the data presented credit card company backed me and the money was refunded. This was after 4.5 months of dispute LESSON Take screenshots of important parts of the transaction with date and time. this saved me.
reviews.author: Dave G

reviews.title: extremely Poor costumer service attitude
reviews.text: Flight was late 30 min in Brussel , then rush shuffle passenger to plane , absolutely irresponsible , without respect to passenger boarding staff , insisted to check in my cabin suitcase to check in as the plane is full( which they say always, i saw there are plenty space on cabins luggage later)and i am in emergency seat ! i kept resisted to do that ! one of boarding guys came ,grab my suitcase then put the tags on my passport and send me away , no words or whatsoever !!! It was shocking and i was panic what was just happened !!! i had medication on my suitcase which it must be with me all the time but its clear as crystal they dont care about your comfort and respect . It has been absolutely terrible experience for International airline such as Brussel airline and down grade the international reputation especially in Brussel ( the heart of the airline) I need formal apology and compensation from the airline which it caused the nightmare and humiliation for me as a passenger ,paying the ticket , then facing disrespect.
reviews.author: James A

reviews.title: Good for European connections
reviews.text: This is a summary of several flights over a couple of weeks. Brussels airlines is okay, without much more. Compared to other airlines, like TAP or Austrian, it's just that bit less, showing that BA depends on the policies of the big brother, considering it rather as a low-cost daughter. Friendly crew, clean and efficient, yes for sure! And with my SA Gold level I won't complain about practicalities!
reviews.author: Philip P

reviews.title: Terrible
reviews.text: I can tell you, this is the worst flying experience of my life. If you have children, I highly recommend going to Lufthansa or Austrian Airlines. Or Aegian. Anything!
reviews.author: Mary R

reviews.title: TERRIBLE SERVICE
reviews.text: I traveled with this airline on 01/03/2023. August made sure I paid extra for an exit seat. This is because I require extra leg room for flight for the flight from Brussels to Entebbe. This is due to health and comfort reasons. Especially on long haul flights. I contacted customer service before my flight and they confirmed I was going to get an exit seat. They even allocated a seat number to me. I was amazed when I got on board and the allocated seat was not an exit seat as promised. Crew on board stated that the exit seats were all occupied. I was baffled. I had to go to thier Kampala office to make sure this was not repeated on the return leg. Since my return I have been chasing a refund for an unfulfilled service. After all the back and forth with calls and submitting requested evidence Brussels airlines decided I was not entitled to a refund because I only paid the flights between Brussels and Entebbe rather than the full journey between London and Entebbe. This is ridiculous. Why do you make it possible to make payment for a service that you say you do not deliver. This is scandalous. I am very annoyed. Secondly, I discovered my suitcase was torn when I arrived Entebbe. I was asked by airline officials to report it to their Kampala office which I did. They took possession of the suitcase promising to sort it out. All they did was put a big patch on the torn area and return the suitcase to me. I can no longer use it for journeys. How can you damage my property and not re
reviews.author: SML

reviews.title: Horrible staff don’t fly with them!
reviews.text: Really rude airline at boarding gates. Shouting, arrogance and really ignorant. Will not fly with them again.
reviews.author: sorcha h

reviews.title: bad customer service and changes of expansive flight to a cheaper flight without any compensation
reviews.text: The flight was on July 2022. I ordered direct flight, and only 5 hours before the flight they cancelled my flight and replace it with one connection flight. I paid a lot of money so the flight will be direct one, and they haven't gave me any compensation for the replacement with cheaper flight (because of the connection). I try to make a contact with their customer service since August 2022 and they like 3 month later, an answer that they asked me for more detail. I send them the details and they haven't answer me yet. It was almost a year ago!!!!
reviews.author: Anna Anna123456

reviews.title: Great service, punctual, comfortable
reviews.text: We were an hour late leaving but that's pretty usual these days. Seats were comfortable, entertainment system was good. Service was excellent, food was decent. No issues with the flight overall.
reviews.author: Marija G

reviews.title: dissapointed
reviews.text: its very dissapointing that brussels is a big and trust worthy airline but it still looses peoples bags this honestly shouldnt be happenning my mom is the one who flew with brussels she came back to paris today on arrival she waited normally for her bag as others were waiting too. only to end up waiting for more than one hour and eventually beeing told her bag isnt there along with over 15-20 other peoples bags are missing...... Do better brussels!!!!
reviews.author: nelly n

reviews.title: Never received my golf bag
reviews.text: I was extremely disappointed by their service.. I am a professional golfer and was traveling for a tournament in Amsterdam via Brussels. My bag didn’t arrive with me and they said it will arrive the next day. I called to see if it had arrived and they said my bag was in Brussels so I drove 2 HOURS to go get it. Turns out it wasn’t there. I never received my bag the entire week, a week later when I arrived back at Madrid Barajas airport, my golf bag was abandoned on one of the belts. I emailed customer service about the damage they have caused but they stopped replying after a while AND I never received an apology. Truly disappointing.
reviews.author: Amanda W

reviews.title: Instant home feeling from boarding, in-flight service with a smile, good food and beverages, helpful
reviews.text: The smile and spontaneity of the cabin crew immediately creates a feeling of coming home and tranquility. Fortunately, as the flight was slightly delayed and the travellers were therefore slightly displeased. The boarding process was somewhat chaotic i.e. the signs and rows with business class and economy were switched (so people had to line up again in another row) and a translation error and pronunciation by the staff at the gate caused confusion between the "pre" boarding group (e.g. people with young children and special assistance) and "boarding group 3". Boarding itself - once off to a good start - went quickly (the flight was not fully booked). Some rows were free and in business class the seats in the middle row were free (pleasant for couples). Business saver is worth the price (fast track so you save time, access to the Lufthansa lounge at Athens airport with excellent food and drinks, priority boarding and baggage allowance, extra baggage allowed in the cabin). Excellent service during the flight. The cabin crew is super friendly and helpful. Several people had a connection flight in Brussels and were reassured they could make it, if necessary with extra help and accelerated disembarkation once they arrived in Brussels at the airport. Tasty meal (vegetarian on Thursday) and extensive choice of drinks. Tasty snacks savory and sweet. A sweet and authentic touch are the Belgian pralines for dessert. We highly recommend this airline and will continue to use their servi
reviews.author: Luxury Journey

reviews.title: Comfortable travel, punctual, excellent service, communicative, authentically Belgian
reviews.text: Punctual. Warm welcome. Excellent in-flight service with a smile. Comfortable seats and ample legroom. An added value is that you get an extra seat (free) in the middle in business class (we booked as a couple). The upgrade to business saver is worth it because of the fast track, lounge access (if open; we prefer a morning flight and the lounge at Brussels Airport opens at 5.30AM), extra baggage you can take into the cabin (two carry-ons and one personal item per person plus 2 x 32kg check-in baggage per person); priority baggage also included. Large overhead bins. The flight from Brussels to Athens was in the morning: the breakfast is tasty, strong coffee, wide choice of tea, enough sandwiches and sweets. An extra touch are the authentic Belgian biscuits that you get as a snack and can keep as a promotional gift or thank you to the staff in your accommodation. We have been flying with this airline for years and can highly recommend it. We will definitely use their services again in the future.
reviews.author: Luxury Journey

reviews.title: No respons after our luggages never showed up
reviews.text: After a trip to portugal our luggage ended up in Toulouse. We did not get our luggage back until we came home. We have been trying to get in contact about refusion, but it is impossiple. no response for 5 month. Horrible
reviews.author: Rune Holst N

reviews.title: Luggage delays and poor service
reviews.text: Poor service. Wrong information. Lack of empathy with passengers. Expensive tickets which do not correspond to the service quality nor professionalism.
reviews.author: Sonia V.M.

reviews.title: Bureaucratic Nightmare. Don’t fly with them.
reviews.text: This airline had an extremely long line at check in because they weigh EVERYTHING. Even my purse! We had an extra bag that we needed to pay for. We had to go to another counter to pay for it because they couldn’t accept extra baggage payment there. Then we had to bring that bag back after paying for it at another counter. This is a prime example of European bureaucracy. Nightmare. Plan ahead. You will need at least an 1 1/2 hours to get rid of your checked bags.
reviews.author: likeitnice1968

reviews.title: Absolutely garbage
reviews.text: Seat space is ridiculous for any one over 5" 5. I booked a seat thinking it was an extra legroom seat but was mistaken, this seat cost me 30 dollars, I contacted an online agent to be kept on hold for 20 minutes all to be told the ancillary purchases I.e seat purchases are non refundable and cannot be amended, so basically I'd have to repurchase another seat at full price instead of having the extra 35 dollars charged to me for 65 dollor extra legroom seat. I'm 6" 6 and literally cannot sit in a regular seat and also told the agent this but to my surprise she cancels the chat and refuses to assist me further worst airline for customer services and to add insult my departure flight was 1 hour late departing but is there any good will gesture for this of course not, fly BA where at least you get good customer service and better leg space
reviews.author: S P

reviews.title: Worst customer service ever
reviews.text: Called the customer service, the staff was very unfriendly and arrogant insisting she couldn't understand anything I was saying, but I was just telling her the booking reference and my name. I have been living in the UK for four years and communicating with people from different countries in English everyday and never did anyone say they cannot understand me because of my accent. At last she refused to answer any of my questions and kept saying "I cannot understand because you have accent" and insisted I should change the language choice. I called service centres of other flight companies several times before and this never happened.
reviews.author: Ciel

reviews.title: No, thank you Brussels airlines - never again
reviews.text: Waiting in 7 h for connecting flight home to OSL. Asking for water, no you must pay! Spending a lot of Euros on the airport, who cares. A short check on the passenger list and the stuarts will understand that there are "long distance customers" that's it. No not with Brussels Airlines! Sorry
reviews.author: axels

reviews.title: Some good points but so much room for improvement
reviews.text: I was flying to Brussels from Singapore. Without a direct flight, I chose this connecting flight from Milan as I had never flown Brussels Airlines before. While it wasn't the airline's fault, public announcements at Milan Malpensa were far too soft, making it difficult to figure out when my boarding group was called. This was a full flight and the boarding process was rather slow - a common experience these days due to many passengers wanting to load their carry-on luggage in the overhead bins. Once seated, the flight attendants kept a sharp look-out that safety measures were adhered to prior to take-off - certainly a good sign. There was no complimentary beverage offering (all items, including water, needed to be purchased) - again, an increasingly common feature on flights worldwide. Furthermore, the Airbus A319 did not have seat-back inflight entertainment systems. So while uneventful, the flight was, thankfully, only just over an hour long. Overall, a flight experience that could improve with just a few minor changes here and there. For the moment, just don't get your expectations up and you won't be disappointed.
reviews.author: ianwyj
